title: What Pleases You Comes to Pass
subtitle: So Purakh · Ang 11
summary: This shabad loosens panic by relocating authorship. What arrives is not outside Divine seeing, giving, or mercy.
whyItMatters: It steadies the mind when outcomes feel personal, unfair, or impossible to control.
takeaway: Receive the day as given, then answer it with Naam.

lines.translation: You are the True Creator, my Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਥੀਸੀ ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਹਉ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo tau bhaavai soiee theesee jo too(n) dheh soiee hau paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whatever pleases You comes to pass. As You give, so do we receive. ||1||Pause||
All belong to You, all meditate on you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no kirapaa kareh tin naam ratan paiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who are blessed with Your Mercy obtain the Jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
The Gurmukhs obtain it, and the self-willed manmukhs lose it.
You Yourself separate them from Yourself, and You Yourself reunite with them again. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) dhareeaau sabh tujh hee maeh ||
lines.translation: You are the River of Life; all are within You.
There is no one except You.
All living beings are Your playthings.
The separated ones meet, and by great good fortune, those suffering in separation are reunited once again. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no too jaanaieh soiee jan jaanai ||
lines.translation: They alone understand, whom You inspire to understand;

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun sadh hee aakh vakhaanai ||
lines.translation: they continually chant and repeat the Lord's Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin har seviaa tin sukh paiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who serve You find peace.
They are intuitively absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: too aape karataa teraa keeaa sabh hoi ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are the Creator. Everything that happens is by Your Doing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh bin dhoojaa avar na koi ||
lines.translation: There is no one except You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: too kar kar vekheh jaaneh soi ||
lines.translation: You created the creation; You behold it and understand it.
O servant Nanak, the Lord is revealed through the Gurmukh, the Living Expression of the Guru's Word. ||4||2||

structure: Begins by placing all arrival inside Divine pleasure and giving.
Expands from the individual to all beings, showing that nothing stands outside the One.
Closes by pairing mercy with understanding, service, and the revealing work of the Guru.

evidence.coreClaim: This shabad loosens panic by relocating authorship. What arrives is not outside Divine seeing, giving, or mercy.
